items.title: Lever
items.desc: Bu alan uçuş ekibi emniyet kemerleri ve gözlemci koltuğu sisteminin teknik detaylarını barındırır. İlgili prosedürler AMOS sistemi üzerinden takip edilir.

subHotspots.title: Landing Gear Indicator Lights
subHotspots.desc: Detay: NOTE: The landing gear warning horn is deactivated with all gears down and locked. NOTE: Landing gear is down and locked as long as one green landing gear indicator light (center panel or overhead panel) for each gear is on. Extinguishes when the landing gear is not down and locked. Landing Gear Indicator Lights (P5 Overhead Panel 3, green) Same explanation as above Landing Gear Indicator Lights (3, red) Illuminated (red) − Appears when the landing gear is not down and locked. This happens with either or both forward thrust levers retarded to idle, and below 800 feet AGL (Above Ground Level). − Appears also always when the related landing gear is in disagreement with the position of the landing gear lever (either when in transit or when unsafe). Extinguishes when the landing gear is up and locked with landing gear lever in UP or OFF. or landing gear is down and locked with landing gear lever DN.

subHotspots.title: Nose Wheel steering
subHotspots.desc: These are the components of the nose wheel steering system in the flight compartment: - Steering wheel - Auxiliary nose wheel steering switch - Rudder pedals. The proximity switch electronics unit (PSEU) is in the FWD equipment compartment Nose Wheel Steering Switch, ALT – hydraulic system B provides power for nose wheel steering. NORM (guarded position) – hydraulic system A provides power for nose wheel steering.
